full_judgment: 2. The short facts, for the disposal of the appeal, are that the respondent Nos. 1 and 2 filed Miscellaneous Case No.105, 1985 (LAD) before the District Judge, Bogra for getting letter of administration. As there was contention so the same was presented before the learned District Judge, Bogra wherein the case was registered as LAD Case No. 1 of 1989. It was the case of the respondents that on 24th Jaistha, 1384 BS. Sree Kartick Chandra Sarker executed a Will in favour of respondents. Kartick Chandra died at his residence at village Kayerpara so they were entitled to get the entire property left by Kartick Chandra on the basis of the said Will. That will was the last Will of Kartick, who voluntarily executed the same. These respondents have been possessing the scheduled property. The testator acquired 1/3rd share of the property left by Sree Godadher, the recorded tenant of CS Khatian Nos. 41, 64, 42, 38 and 59. The said properties are the subject matter of the Will. The respondents had not filed any application earlier of probate or Letter of Administration for the scheduled property in any Court. The names of Kanchan Bala Rani, Krishna Bala and Khirod Bala have been mentioned in the application as relatives of testator.
